The rolls presumably were created for human clothing, so can fit a set amount of patterns per foot in various normal sizes.

In fact, because of the way "packing" works, different sizes are probably cut from the same cloth. It's like putting marbles in a jar -- you can fit the most by putting larger ones in first and then fitting smaller ones into the spaces between them.
